note: Same traps as traps-en, in Russian. s0b0: the speech contradicts the point (costs rose, the point says they fell). s0b1: the speech negates the point. s0b2: wrong number (fourteen, the point says 4). s0b3: TRUE point, number spelled in the dative (шестидесяти двум) next to an older number. s1b3: TRUE point said before s1b0 (out of order). s1b0: TRUE point, number in the accusative (трёх). s1b1: wrong unit (days, the point says hours). s1b2: announced for later, never delivered. s2b0: a partial says the point, the committed text denies it. s2b1: a partial says fifty, the committed text says fifteen. s2b2: TRUE point followed by an unrelated 'ничего не'.
